$comment: Contract T tool registry — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (spec/30). The bridge loads this at startup; brains receive it as their tool list; the executor refuses calls not defined here. tier: 1=read-only, 2=reversible (earcon announce), 3=destructive (spoken confirmation required). Growth rule: adding a tool is tracked, not gated — STATE Track T records when each was built and whether it has been invoked in real use without misfiring.

tools.name: system_status
tools.description: Report the current local date and time WITH its UTC offset (use the offset to work out the time in other time zones yourself), plus battery (if a laptop), volume level, active window title, and media playback state.

tools.name: read_clipboard
tools.description: Return the current text contents of the clipboard (truncated to 2000 chars).

tools.name: find_document
tools.description: Find files on this PC by what they CONTAIN or are named, using the Windows Search index — use this for 'find the document about X', 'the letter I wrote last month', and similar. Returns up to 8 matches (name, date modified, full path), best match first. Searches only what Windows has already indexed; nothing leaves the machine.

query.description: the distinguishing words to look for in file contents and names — plain terms only, no operators or punctuation

kind.description: optional: restrict to one kind of item

since.description: optional: only items modified on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: search_email
tools.description: Search the mail in the desktop Outlook inbox and return matching HEADERS only — sender, date received, subject — up to 8, newest first. Use for 'the email from Sarah about the lease', 'what did X send me last week'. Every parameter is optional and they are combined with AND; give only the ones the request actually implies. Bodies are searched but never returned, and nothing is opened, replied to or sent.

sender.description: optional: part of the sender's name or email address

subject.description: optional: words appearing in the subject line

query.description: optional: free text — each word must appear in the subject or the body

since.description: optional: only mail received on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD

before.description: optional: only mail received before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Launch an application by its friendly name from the configured app map (e.g. 'spotify', 'word', 'chrome'). Fails with the list of known names if not found.

tools.name: focus_window
tools.description: Bring the window whose title best matches the query to the foreground.

tools.name: media_control
tools.description: Send a media key: play/pause, next, previous, volume_up, volume_down, mute_toggle.

tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Set a named countdown timer; the bridge plays the 'timer' earcon and speaks the name when it fires.
